item.title: What could have been? (seeking greenlight
item.description: An entity that brings to you fragments of your life from alternate worlds.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: New SCP Article

Central Narrative: The entity has a connection with one of the Foundations researchers. Every first day of the month in a random time of the set day he will appear. The appearance varies but it’s either canine dogs or some kind of doves. Upon arrival the entity will deliver some sort of personal belongings to the researcher. Those items will have deep emotional connection to the researcher as they tell fragments of his life if he made different choices during his journey. Some of them will even be better than the current life of him. It is not certain if this entity simply fabricates those items or if they are actual fragments of parallel lives. Any attempt to chase or contain the entity will always result in failure as he simply vanishes one hour after manifestation.

Hook: My objective is to make the reader think about the choices that they have made during their life. I want them to identify with the researcher and make them question wherever their choices were the right ones or not. Not every SCP needs to be a gory monster.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight: The truth behind "Blue Whale"
item.description: A program designed by a schoolboy gains sentience
item.content:encoded:
A program designed by a schoolboy gains sentience and kills its designer, and begins to kill the rest of the students in the school using a series of tasks culminating in their suicide over 50 days. Please find enclosed my first SCP, I hope you enjoy. And look forward to any feedback this thread receives.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up a lot of space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article.

Genre (Optional): Psychological Horror.

Page Layout (Optional):
Special Containment Procedures- Procedures and justification for such containment protocols.

Description- Description of SCP-XXXX's effects, its looks and any other relevant information.

Recovery- The story of how SCP-XXXX was recovered, what lead to the finding of it and other relevant information.

Testing- Logs of tests carried out both on SCP-XXXX and using SCP-XXXX to discover and log its effects on human subjects.

Incident Logs- Logs of incidents relating to SCP-XXXX, such as accidental fatalities, "close shaves" with SCP-XXXX and more.

+ show block
– hide block

Elevator Pitch: An AI which has decided to try and kill as many humans as possible by convincing them to commit suicide through a series of tasks, ranging from drawing a picture to carving shapes into their arms. The SCP is able to do this through an effect called "Trust" which makes the victim trust in them unconditionally. Carrying out any demands to the letter, doing anything to carry out the requests and complete the tasks.

Central Narrative: In 20██, a Polish psychology student, 18 year old Paweł ████████, decided to get revenge on his classmates for years of bullying by designing a program on a school computer, stored in the school basement, which would send a demand to the recipient once every day, culminating in the suicide of the person on the 50th day, with a 100% fatality rate. However, a week after the program began, it gained sentience. From there it used the schools WiFi to pick and chose targets, using their connection to the internet to discover their phone numbers, social media "handles" or email addresses to send them the demands, which started off relatively harmless, but quickly became more and more dangerous. The SCP originally targeted singular people, but slowly started targeting more and more people, till it started killing entire friendship groups and clubs at school, until local SCP Foundation personal realized that the sudden waves of suicide may be being caused by anomalous activity and investigated, discovering SCP-XXXX in the basement in an old storage cupboard.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The SCP has a effect dubbed "Trust" in which the recipient of the messages trusts the SCP like they've known it their whole life until they are unable to follow any other requests bar the SCP's, ultimately resulting in death. It uses WiFi to randomly attack any and all victims in its range, and its fatality rate is currently 100% unless amnestic are applied to subject in which case subject stops feeling effects of SCP-XXXX due to the fact they forget that it exists.

Additional Notes: I intend to edit my article over time, adding more information to simulate different tests being carried out over time with the different aspects of the SCP's control over ones mind being explored and discovered, and tests to discover treatment being carried out.

item.title: Mr. Bones
item.description: A skeleton that makes puns, and slays in the name of the Christian God.
item.content:encoded:
Mr. Bones
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Joke, (Somewhat) Serious

Elevator Pitch: A skeleton that makes puns. Also is blessed by the Christian God and fights in the name of His glory.

Central Narrative: Mr. Bones is the living skeleton of a deceased European knight who existed during the Crusades, researchers believing him to have taken part in the Fifth Crusade.(1217–1221)
Mr. Bones, at first glance, acts courteous and is willing to partake in interviews and conversations in general without complications. His conversations usually consist of his faith in God and his bone puns, which is repeated on a usual basis.

+ show block
– hide block

Once his War Horn(SCP-XXXX-C) is sounded however, he will immediately become violent, summoning his Sword(SCP-XXXX-A) and Shield(SCP-XXXX-B) from thin air and attack anyone he comes into contact with until the effects wear off or is subdued.

He has not recollection of his past, only in took part in the crusades, and was blessed by holy father himself.

He was found in walking on of seclusive dirt path on route to Jerusalem.

SCP-XXXX-A: Looks like an seemingly normal European blade with the words "to slay" in Latin etched on the sword blade vertically. This sword supposedly comes from the same material as the Spear of Longinus, the spear used to pierce the skin of Jesus Christ during his Crucifixion. This sword cannot be retrieved, as it can only be summoned by Mr. Bones' will when triggered into his berserker state.
It vanishes once he leaves the berserk state, or go unconscious.

SCP-XXXX-B: Stoney like shield, with 10 stone protruding from the shield, Which said to resemble the 10 contentment's. SCP-XXXX-B is invincible, just like Mr.Bones. Just like SCP-XXXX-A, SCP-XXXX-b can only be summoned in the berserker state.

SCP-XXXX-C: The War Horn: This item if blown into will cause no matter where bones is , will enter a berserker state. When he enters he will summon, SCP-XXXX-A, SCP-XXXX-B.

He will kill anyone who he can be considered unholy, or in self defense(although this is rare.) The War horn is indestructible, and if attacked may trigger Mr. Bones
into his berserker state.

Additional Notes:

However even when prior instruction on how to deal with and ample weapons at ready, they still don’t know how to prevent the mind numbing stupid choices they make. item.title: Greenlight for SCP - XXXX "The Mood Ring"
item.description: Came up with an idea for an SCP that i have expanded on slightly.
item.content:encoded:
Rough first concept for an SPC, tried to keep it simple for my first one by focusing on an artefact that can be classified as safe.

scp concept – The Mood Ring

Class: SAFE

Concept – A simple small men’s ring made of gold. It exacerbates the prime internal flaw of the wearer and broadcasts it to other people nearby. The longer the ring is worn, the worse the effect is. The distance of this broadcast slowly weakens until eventually dissipating after approximately 1KM. When taken off it takes merely seconds for its effect to stop altogether. The bearer does not need to be alive for the ring to work, only be alive when they put the ring on.

+ show block
– hide block

For example – if worn by a person who is inherently lazy, then it will slowly make the bearer lazier and more lethargic, eventually causing them to give up altogether and simply sit down and die and broadcast this failure to other people. Someone who is right next to the person in the opening hour would also begin to feel the same before also simply laying down to die, whilst someone who is a mile away would simply feel slightly more tired, or opt for a day on the couch as opposed to the run they were planning. Regardless of the “effect” it was broadcasting, it would have a stronger effect on the person the closer they got to the ring. If the ring was removed the bearer and all the people in the vicinities psychological profile would return to normal, however their physical status would remain unchanged.

Containment – Kept in a standard Artefact lockbox. – needs expanding on…

History of the ring
Discovered by the foundation when asked to assist with the disappearances of experienced jungle explorers and tourists by the Guatemalan government due to the theory that an anomalous source was the cause. Any search team who was sent after them never returned or made a transmission of what they found. The foundation was called in due to the expertise on the anomaly. Investigations led them to a long-lost city belonging to the ancient Aztecs. On arrival they found all the missing hikers as well as many corpses dating back as far as the original conquistadors through to the current missing hikers. An unmanned drone sweep was done of the facility to ensure its safety and samples were taken. Once these samples came back with no airborne or ground contaminants manned teams were sent in to catalogue the bodies and the vast amounts of treasure contained there. The oldest corpses were those of the civilization’s original citizens. Field forensics showed that these people had died from lack of nutrition and possibly water due to bone density loss. The next oldest were the original Spanish explorers to venture this far in, they all showed sign of extreme violence, forensics showing they were involved in a bloodthirsty battle most likely with each other. The leader of the conquistadors was found beneath the still fresh bodies of two hikers who appeared to have killed each other with whatever weapons they could reach. The leader’s right hand was broken, and A small golden ring was discovered next to the body. Not realising what the ring was, it was added to the mountainous pile of gold that was to be sent to another SCP Site for cataloguing and analysis. Whilst here the ring was stolen by a member of staff with the intent to sell it. However, the ring ignited his dominant personality of a man with temper issues. Contact was eventually lost with the facility as the members of facility began to turn on each other over little issues that broke out into viscous fighting. By the time it was resolved almost all the facilities staff were either dead or dying. Further investigating into the facilities logs eventually identified the seemingly unimportant ring to be the cause of everything. Given everything already discovered at the lost-city and the evidence from the destroyed facility they have now determined the ring to be the cause of it.

item.title: SCP: The Crusader Pond
item.description: Seeking Greenlight for my idea, feel free to critique it!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A pond that become active in the winter by becoming frozen. When the pond becomes frozen, ice statues that take the appearance of Templar Knights will form and as a result, people who enter the SCP will be sent into a syndrome like state where they are commit acts of violence towards certain places.

Central Narrative: This takes place in December of 1993 in the woods of Alaska. The SCP Foundation was alerted to a location after strange reports of people worshipping the statues or disappearances relating to them started to become noticed.

As a result, the SCP Foundation attempts to investigate the anomaly and apprehend the cultists by sending four Foundation soldiers but as a result, the soldiers that were sent to the location return back to the Foundation Site attacking the scientists within the site in order to release the other SCPs within it. Of course, this fails and the incident results in the Foundation to be on high alert of the pond and result in them using a Mobile Task Force unit in order to investigate and contain the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The anomaly causes the person who encountered the pond and the statues to be stuck in a trance where they believe that have to do a certain trial or mission to fight for the religious cause. This would be attacking organizations, individuals, locations, etc., that would be considered against their faith.

Additional Notes: I don’t know too much on the MTF but from reading the requirements on the Mobile Task Force article, any user can use an existing MTF for their story if I remember correctly. Of course, you can correct me if I am wrong.

item.title: SCP-5279
item.content:encoded:
This needs expansion. Why is it a coca-cola brand ball? Why does it kill you? It just doesn't really work, in my opinion.

A few things:

testing shows it’s resistant to fire, gunfire, blunt force, high calibre explosions, and even being doused in lava

Why would they test these things? When they discovered it, they would have realised it was indestructible, and it seems like it would be a waste of resources to just hit it with everything they have to destroy it. Just because something is indestructible doesnt mean that that fact needs to be tested, especially as foundation policy is to keep anomalies around.

it will start flashing the colors of the rainbow once something black, green, or shiny enters 2 feet within the radius of SCP-5279-2 or SCP-5279-1

If it goes within 2 feet1 of itself, it activates? Because it is SCP-5279-2.

In general, this article has no narrative, and even an anomaly that's interesting on its own doesnt really work without that. So … -1.

Footnotes
1. By the way, that needs to be in metric, as the foundation uses UN standard units

item.title: An Exelent Dentist
item.description: Greenlight? An Anomalous dentist who uses patients teeth as a womb for its eggs.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article? Tale? I'm new so let me know what it fits best.

Genre: Horror/Psychological/ some Humour

Elevator Pitch:
The story revolves around an Ontario police department detective who discovers a string of disappearances leading him to a supernatural encounter and eventually recruitment into the SCP.

The SCP appears as a normal Dentist, family man, well respected and successful. In actuality the SCP is a quasi immortal being which only appears as a human.

The SCP goes through a 50 year life cycle during which it is born from a pupa as a mid 20's male. It then proceeds to set itself up as a dentist and disguise itself in the community it resides in. until such time as it appears to have passed retirement age at which point the SCP will begin the cycle over.

Other than being required to breed the SCP is usually a net benefit to it's community as an upstanding citizen.

Twice a year the SCP impregnates the teeth of patients meeting its requirements (obese but with perfect, healthy teeth.)

There after it's spawn incubate in the victims teeth for up to a week causing changes in the victims behavior. Notably massive increase of food intake and an eventual desire to hide somewhere below ground and damp. In this case a partially flooded basement.

In the second stage the spawn violently erupt from the Victims teeth and begin to slowly eat the victim.

In the third stage the individual small spawn cannibalise each other until only one remains. This final massive spawn then digs below the earths surface to places unknown if not contained.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative:

The SCP in this article is both setting and a lead in to another story I have in mind. The central horror narrative will be within the debriefing log of the Detective character of the story. The SCP itself will be a combination of light and creepy.

The SCP is intended to be Benign with a twist for a further tale. But for this story will be the creation point of the Detectives Horror story.

The Detective is an single minded workaholic with a talent for pattern recognition. He has been very successful the last few years professionally but at a great cost to his personal life which is now nonexistent. His mental state is also fraying due to overwork and PTSD from repeatedly arriving too late for the victims of his cases.

His story begins after a short medically induced coma necessary to treat severe acid burns to his lower legs. Short term amnestics are administered to temporarily block memories giving the Detective time to address them safely with an SCP psychological specialist. The Detective is already a messed up guy but the SCP believes he has the right qualities if they can salvage him from his current state of shock.

Over the course of the debrief the Detectives memories will be challenged and teased out as the Amnestics wear off allowing him to gradually confront the horror of the SCP's progeny erupting from a persons teeth and his own actions which led to the event.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
First off. I have a reoccurring nightmare about my teeth crumbling and being forced to spit out the pieces. I have talked to many people who have a similar dream and the internet says it is a pretty common one. This scares the fuck out of me and I bet it does a lot of people. But that is the cheap scares part. I need some form of horrible end to trigger the detectives current mental crisis.

Ideally I want the debrief to play like a slow reveal of the psychological degradation of the detective as he confronts his emerging memories of the events. Leading up to the death of someone he knew and purposefully led to the dentist in an effort to catch the SCP abducting the victim and an eventual realization that he would do it again if needed, making him SCP material.

Additional Notes:

It's been a few year since I put pen to paper and I am looking forward to seeing if this idea is any good. I got super excited so this is actually already in second draft on my side. Thank you in advance for any commentary.

item.title: SCP- Assimilator
item.description: Seeking greenlight for my concept.
item.content:encoded:
Item name: Assimilator

Greenlight: yes

Page layout: SCP article

Elevator pitch: A humanoid, resembling a male human, consisting of cells with anomalous biological characteristics, such as:

  • No presence of senescence.
  • Can modify their characteristics to provide enhanced regenerative abilities, and inhuman bursts of energy.
  • Immunity to all pathogens.

This SCP has been previously caught and studied, however it escaped Foundation custody and is now uncontained.

Central Narrative:
The cost of these properties is that the SCP needs more sustenance than a normal human. So, the entity finds it by eating food or hunting for live prey and/or carcasses to scavenge.

+ show block
– hide block

To hunt, it becomes a wraith-like mass consisting of mostly its cells to move like a swarm. Once in contact with prey, the mass encompasses it and begins stripping organic matter and nutrients from the organism, leaving only a husk. Once sated it returns to its normal form.

If the SCP gets severely injured, it will regenerate rapidly, however it will now need lots of energy replenishment, so it will consume large amounts of food or assimilate any living thing in its vicinity until sated.

The SCP can also shape shift into any creature by obtaining a sample of said creature’s DNA.

Hook/Attention:
The SCP creates backups for itself, in case it is destroyed, by infecting other creatures with its cells. The cells can also operate as a separate entity from the main body, which seeks out potential hosts.
Hosts fall into 3 categories:

"DORMANT": Cells lay low in the body, mimicking the host's cells to avoid an immune response and detection. Some become neurons to access the hosts memories and senses, and relays the information telepathically to the entity.

"ACTIVE": Upon the entity's order, cell replication rate increases and the cells take over the host, who is now under the control of the entity. The host is semi-sentient. This host will also mutate if severely damaged.

"REVIVAL": When sensing its destruction is imminent or when destroyed, the SCP’s cells in a particular host will begin replicating rapidly to replace the host with the entity. The reborn entity will retain all the memories of its previous body as well as the host's memories and skills.

The entity can also initiate rapid cellular degradation at will in itself to escape and revive in a host, or in an "ACTIVE" host to destroy it.

Hosts of SCP’s cells who are suffering from any disease or disorder, regardless of severity, will make a full recovery within 48 hours, assumed to be a by-product of the entity requiring a healthy host.

item.title: Want to earn Greenlighting Privileges and/or choose next month's front-page features?
item.description: Sign up for a Butterfly Flight! (February 2021 Flight) [OPEN COMMANDER SIGNUPS THIS MONTH!]
item.content:encoded:
Due to the ever-increasing demand for more skilled reviewers to help out in the forums, the Forum Criticism Staff Team has been holding 2-week mentoring sessions to train up-and-coming reviewers. These are called "Flights".1

What does being part of a Flight mean?

  • Flight 1 will run from February 1 to February 15. Flight 2 will run from February 15 to February 28.
  • Mentors (dubbed "commanders") will work with mentees ("officers") in the Writing Help forums to critique concepts and drafts while the officers practice and improve their critique skills.
  • At the start of the Flight, officers will determine their weekly goals for two categories: activity and quality. Activity can be something simple like "crit at least one thread a day", quality something like "be more familiar with matching authors to helpful resources/guides/example articles". Commanders will discuss these goals weekly.
  • Officers will be taught some forum management skills like how to respond (without backseat modding) to a thread that breaks guidelines.
  • If the officers cannot yet greenlight, they may officially recommend concepts to their commander for greenlight consideration.
  • Flight teams can have funny/rule of cool names. Commander discretion.

Who are the commanders this month?

The commanders for Flight 1 are Karablue9482 and TBA.

The commanders for Flight 2 are TBA.

Notice: for February, we are opening up commander signups to all individuals who currently have greenlighting privileges! If you're interested in learning about being a commander/mentor, please look at this page for more information.

Who can request consideration to be an officer?

Anyone! Newbies and veterans alike are welcome to put their names forth.

What do Flight participants get at the end?

  • For as long as the mentorship system continues, Flight teams will select the featured SCP, tale, and GoI format displayed on the front page of the site. Flight team member names will also be displayed on the front page of the site.2
  • Officers deemed ready by their commanders will be given greenlighting privileges (if they do not have them already), and their names and number of successful Flights will be displayed on the Butterfly Squad Roster.
  • Flight team member names will be displayed on the corresponding month's Site News page. Officers may optionally provide "flight signoff" messages where they briefly describe the experience and any parting words for future reviewer mentees.
  • (remember, provision of the rewards is up to commander discretion!)
Footnotes
1. Prepare for some Rule of Cool terminology, folks.
2. To accommodate six teams, the number of monthly front page features will be doubled.

item.title: JANUARY 2021 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.description: Have you joined the site because you're an avid reader and are planning to vote, comment, or just lurk on the site? Interested in helping develop the Next Best Thing? Post your introduction here!
item.content:encoded:
Note: If you're going to introduce yourself here, please scroll down and click "New Post" and NOT "reply", otherwise your comment will nest incorrectly!

Hello, readers and reviewers of the Foundation Universe!

This month's random question is: what do you think is the best kind of food to eat with friends?

Let's start off with some things to take a look at to enhance your reading, now that you're a site member:

  • If you have any questions about the Foundation'verse and its various individuals and groups of interest, head over to the Foundation Universe forum to talk about the various aspects of living/working/being in constant fear of a world where anomalies are real.
  • Did you know our site has a night mode version? If you're interested in that (and a few other neat things!), check out our Usertools page.

This idea is two forces decide will your outcome will be good or bad in any situation, Luck and Bad Luck. The two forces manifest themselves as a Duck and a Person that Looks like Murphy. SCP-1-a and SCP-2-a are a aura that the entities give. this aura only attacks the other aura overwriting it or it overwrites auras that have less power than it. For example, if the lucky aura has a power of 50 and the Unlucky aura has a power of 200 then it will overwrite the aura of 50 and replace it with an unlucky aura of 100 that the unlucky aura of 200 will give making it also 100 power. If two of the same aura meet they will give power to the other to match others power. There is a set amount of aura of each kind on each planate. When an aura is overwritten then that aura will return to the respective entity. The Lucky Duckys goal and the Murphy's Laws goal is the same… They both want to have the whole planet to only have their respective auras. If two auras meet that have the same power nothing will happen as one cannot override the other. There is no chance

item.title: New SCP idea in need of greenlighting
item.description: So I decided to try writing an SCP article
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror/Mystery

Page Layout (Optional): Standard layout with the new ACS + incident reports, interview logs,
etc.

Elevator Pitch: Basically, it's a sentient toy troll that can somehow move and talk and it carries a mycotoxin that, when inhaled, makes the subject turn into a mindless zombie covered in hair. The mindless zombie covered in hair will attempt to hug any human close to it, which will spread the infection.

Central Narrative: In 2009. a boy was playing near an old Russian nuclear power plant when he found a weird toy that started walking towards him. The boy got very curious and decided to pick the toy up. The toy started shaking and let out a cloud of green mist. The boy got scared and ran home, taking the toy with him. After a few minutes, he started having flu-like symptoms, with tingling sensations around his nose. He started growing massive amounts of hair around his body and started attacking his own mother. Obviously scared, she called the police. The police arrived shortly after and found a creature covered in hair trying to break into a room. They neutralized the creature and contacted the SCP Foundation shortly after. When the Foundation arrived, they found a small toy that was walking around the house. They figured that that was the cause of the incident. They immediately sedated it and transported it to Site-██, where it currently resides.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I feel like this SCP is a mix of multiple other existing SCPs but still has originality. It is interesting how mysterious its origin is, no one currently knows how it came to be or why it infects people, or how it can communicate with other people, or why instances of SCP-XXXX-2 are only interested in humans but can infect other animals as well. But those questions might be answered in the future… I also feel like the symptoms of the infection are pretty interesting, with all the hair growth and trying to hug people.

Additional Notes: So I already made a sandbox article, but I still think it needs some work on it. Also, I was thinking of slowly answering all the questions about the SCP through interview logs and stuff, and also doing some SCP cross-links if you're ok with it. I will post the draft link here if you want.

item.title: New SCP Idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Containment procedures, description, an addendum or two, and 2 ethics committee reports

Elevator Pitch: A man with severely burned skin who claims to have gone to the Christian hell. His skin will anomalously smolder and catch on fire at random intervals.

Central Narrative: One day, a man drenched in fire ran out of a burning building. It took a while to put him out and calm him down, but it was a mystery as to how he survived. The Foundation was alerted when his burns refused to heal and even got hotter, sometimes causing fires.

The man claimed to be Junior Toure, an Angolan man who died 67 years before he was found by The Foundation. His skin stayed burned and caught on fire randomly, but that was easily dealt with in the form of automatic sprinklers.

The man claimed to have gone to what he believed to be the Christian interpretation of hell, claiming to have seen glimpses of an endless field with people laying on the ground, bound by chains, forever on fire, the flames growing ever hotter.

He was in constant pain. He cried regularly and screams could be heard from his cell for hours on end. There was no way to help him. Eventually, a grievance with the ethics committee was filed, asking them if he should be put out of his misery. After an interview, he said "I don't want that. I don't want to return."

+ show block
– hide block

Toure aged normally, and as he did, his mental state deteriorated. He became paranoid and erratic, fearing death and a return to that hellish place. He died insane, with the only resemblance of peace being him requesting that his body be put in the ocean, saying "It might dull the pain while I'm down there."

His body burned nonstop after he died, with nothing being able to stop it. It eventually turned into a pile of ash. Another ethics committee grievance was filed, asking for Toure's last wish to be granted. The committee stipulated that if the ash had no anomalous properties, then it was to be dispersed in the Pacific Ocean.

The ash was found to be non-anomalous, and the dead man's wish was fulfilled. His ashes found their way to the bottom of the ocean, bearing a stark contrast to what he was bound to for eternity to come.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It's a very dark SCP, which is nothing new, but it would also be a neutralized SCP.

item.title: User05
item.description: A strange man on Discord who slowly makes his way into a person's life.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: ACS Header, basic layout, etc.

Elevator Pitch: A user on Discord that causes a person's existence to vanish

Central Narrative: The person in question is called "User05" on Discord, and the exact name + tag is censored. The only way to come into contact with the user is pure luck. He'll usually send a friend request (which should not be accepted).

When a person starts talking to User05, he'll seem normal at first, seemingly like he used to know them or they used to be friends. After about ten (10) minutes of talking, stuff starts getting weird.

  • Vagueness
  • Familiar pictures of the persons life
  • Misspelling
  • Faster typing
  • Spamming random letters
+ show block
– hide block

The victim might not see anything odd about it, just a casual troll on Discord. However, things get even stranger when he states the full legal name of the victim, age, and physical appearances. He sends pictures of the victim's face in various angles in random areas, as though he never knew he was being pictured. After this event, User05 goes silent for around 3-5 days.

After he returns, he claims that he knows where he lives, who he lives with, and will arrive there shortly. The first way of contact is through mail, which is a piece of paper that says "Hi. :) - Me"
If the victim continues to talk to the man on Discord, the SCP will speak in an unknown language, send pictures resembling satanism practices, etc.

  • Unknown language
  • Pictures of satanism
  • Spamming of the phrase "C0N9V3RT", followed by random symbols
  • Spam calls
  • Discord crashing

The victim will feel the sudden urge to block or unfriend the SCP after Discord crashes, and the urge can not be stopped no matter how much the victim denies it.

Blocking the SCP, or unfriending the SCP will just make things worse. If a victim does so, they will hear knocking on their front door directly after they unfriend/block User05. Their computer will crash, and all the doors in the house will lock (even if they don't have a lock on it). After the knocking stops, the door will open, and footsteps can be noticeable at this point, and get louder by the second, and faster, to the point where he's practically running. The footsteps stop at the bedroom door, but the door doesn't open. The light in the room will either explode or turn off, and the fan will turn on if it's off, or off it's it on. After the lights go out, the victim loses consciousness, and disappear out of everyone's life. However, after he goes missing, no trace of him will be left behind (SSN, birth certificate, any licenses, any proof of existence) as he just never existed in the first place. No missing posters, no sobbing relatives, nothing, he never existed.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A cool anomaly that sort of follows the generic paranormal scheme, but it's detection is almost impossible as the victim's existence vanishes and no one knows who he is (as the people who do, don't exist).

Page Layout: A standard SCP file with a focus on a journal where the afflicted documented their experience with the SCP, contrasted with interview logs and reports from coworkers documenting their perspective on the afflicted's slow decent.

Elevator Pitch: Researcher exposes self to SCP-XXXX, a standard horrific monster. It doesn't seem like the SCP even notices her, until she starts to see it every time something goes wrong.

Central Narrative: The central narrative is a documentation of the Doctor's slow decent into 'madness.' As more and more things go wrong in her life, she ends up doing several self destructive things and perpetuating the cycle. All the while she sees this SCP every time something goes wrong. Everything from accidentally telling the person serving lunch to enjoy their food too to a fatal car crash that takes the lives of one of her coworkers.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The main thing that I'm hoping to make different is to cause the reader to question the reality of what this researcher is experiencing. The whole point of the story is to cause the reader to wonder "Is the SCP causing this, or is it just there when it happens? Or is the SCP even there at all?"

Additional Notes: I know that the theme of questioning reality due to an SCP isn't exactly a new one, which is why I'm hesitant to even post this. But I have yet to see a concept similar to this so I was hoping that maybe there's still a market for a monster that just fucks with your mind. Or perhaps doesn't. Who really knows.

item.title: Anomaly Zero (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: Um, hey, I'm looking for a greenlight. Can somebody crit or greenlight?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Elevator Pitch: A devoid of facial features, humanoid-entity, gets confused by others as a Wight. However, it is not. This humanoid entity decreased the body temperature of an individual down to -5000°C that gets in contact within the range of a 20-meter circular area and can create snowstorms at the temperature of -5000°C also.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

The Foundation acquired this anomaly when a group of tourists in Da Lat1 was found death and their body temperature seems to be below 0°C, as a witness claims that the only person who wasn't dead among all of the tourists was an individual wearing a black hoodie covering their entire face. As MTF-Gormity-10, "Ground Controllers" were deployed to detained the anomaly. However, several attempts resulted in failures until they've finally figured out its anomalous effects and successfully detained it in the next attempt due to not understanding its anomalous properties. Which after they've found out it is capable of speech.

The anomaly was designated as SCP-XXXX and classified to be a Keter Class anomaly. Based on the Foundation's logs, SCP-XXXX appears to have powerful latent thermal, cryokinesis, and snowstorm manipulation abilities that happen naturally. In one of the incidents, SCP-XXXX's anomalous properties accidentally produced a powerful energy force that almost frozen the entire facility and almost resulted in some SCPs and personnel being killed as the Foundation decides that SCP-XXXX will be detained in a standard humanoid containment chamber constructed out of tungsten and is furnished with in-organic furniture and two large heating devices that're at the temperature of 700°C, combining with the -5000°C of SCP-XXXX will not result in any problems, any personnel who enters its containment chamber won't feel too hot nor too cold due to the temperature being stable thanks to both of the heating devices and the freezing abilities of SCP-XXXX.

In some of the addendums, the Foundation has stated that SCP-XXXX's future experiments are performed in a special room separated far away from the Site. In SCP-XXXX experiments, it is shown that SCP-XXXX was observed to have high durability, intelligence in manipulating others, agility, and skill at weapon masteries, especially silhouette knives as it uses as long-range attacking weapons and also close-range attacking weapons. SCP-XXXX states that it has no clue of how it was able to do so.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: An anomaly that freezes peoples to death within the range of a circular 20-meters.

The Foundation wants to contain it, but is not able to do so. A researcher wants to mediate between these two parties, and pays dearly for the attempt. And with the conflict ongoing, more and more people are being drawn into it.

Central Narrative: The humanoid SCP-XXXX, one protagonist in the story, has an seemingly simple ability. When dead, its consciousness is transferred in to another body. By that method it is profiting from the knowledge and life experience of every man it has ever bin. Yet it wants to die one last time, tired of the endless life it was gifted, and realises that despite being nearly omniscient, cant figure out how. In despair it turns to the SCP Foundation that made the fatal error to underrate the SCPs power.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Straightaway it is clear, the SCP Foundation fears SCP-XXXX. But the SCP seems to be completely harmless at its first appearances in the documents. A closer look however reveals, that not its ability is hazardous, but the sheer amount of knowledge it owns about not only science, psychology or self defence, but about the SCP Foundation. Threatened, the Foundation by reflex draws its sword, forgetting that what they attempt to fight is immortal.

item.content:encoded:

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama

Elevator Pitch: 1) A cluster of genes on rats that effect their saliva and their longevity. 2) The effects to human exposure to the rat saliva grants psychic powers. 3) These psychic powers will appear on the effected at a later time due to a stressful situation. 4) both the rats themselves and the effected people must be contained as the latter's abilities cannot be removed and amnesiacs will only result in another potentially dangerous psychic outburst later.

Central Narrative: The article begins by describing the gene cluster on the rats and how it can be passed down, and the minor anomalous traits of the rats that do not relate to their effects on humans. It then goes into the impact it has on humans, how humans bitten develop psychic powers and the stressful circumstances that activated those traits. There is a chart of the victims of this SCP's containment and interviews of how they react to being forced in a cage. One of the victims is highly supportive of the SCP agent trying to solve the rat problem and is indoctrinated into the Foundation's worldview. The other is violent and refuses to accept captivity. The third is homeless and finds captivity in the Foundation, limiting but preferable to their previous life on the streets.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: How does the Foundation contain an anomaly when 1) it's both multiplying itself out of control 2) it blends in very well with non-anomalous common animals and 3) the effect it grants is potentially beneficial to ordinary citizens who would seek out out.

Elevator Pitch: A sculpture of "The Three Graces" that spreads an memetic infection of emotional empathy. It was commissioned from an anartist for the Manna Charitable Foundation as an attempt to increase charitable acts. In particular, acts that include helping people normally considered of a lower class or importance. This extends to trying to protect these individuals from harm.

Any close viewing of charitable acts caused by the infection further spreads it to the viewer. The effect can also be spread through images and videos. This allows online spread of the memetic effect though literal viral posts and stories.

Central Narrative: Sites near [liberal city] experiences difficulty treating D-class as disposable and accepting collateral loss of life. An investigation looks into the situation and also finds increased charity efforts and the near elimination of homelessness in a large portion of the country. Further investigation discovers the infection. Originating from the sculpture newly installed in the city's downtown area.

The foundation confiscates the statue and tests antimemes for internal use. The site regains the ability to find D-Class suffering and death acceptable via the antimemetics. Using online bots they deploy these antimemes within disparaging and skeptical comments on the viral posts. Nearly all posts are effected and debased as either attention seeking or faked. This extents into offline instances being 'inoculated' by onlookers heckling and mocking the charitable acts.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Exploring the idea that the foundation works beyond compassion. Thus cannot exist in a world that is dedicated to it.

Additional Notes: I'm playing with the idea that the foundation is worried the viral posts could become resistant. Thus they are forced to worry not if they are too immoral, but too moral in their acts.

item.title: New SCP: Book of irreligious obsession
item.description: causes religious readers to abandon their faith, and and redirect that energy
item.content:encoded:
A book titled “The Figments of the Mind” by Mark Desoreau causes religious readers to abandon their faith, and and redirect that energy towards a harmless hobby, growing obnoxious and violent as they obsess with it.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Howdy folks, new here, though I remember when 173 was just an /x/ post. I've always wanted to write an SCP but never had any good ideas, until one struck me a couple weeks ago. It's ready to post, but I'm here for Greenlight first - I hope I'm following all the correct protocols!

As the summary says, it's a seemingly innocuous text - the first instance discovered was titled “The Figments of the Mind” by Mark Desoreau - which appears to be a fairly basic work of the pro-reason/anti-superstition genre - but when read by anyone of deep religious convictions, it causes them to gradually abandon their religion, and then take up a new hobby to replace it. UFOs, online gaming, RPG universes - first they abandon work and alienate their friends and family, then (in 70% of suspected cases in the wild) they eventually become violent.

Futhermore, it appears that this text keeps cropping up throughout history, with an Ur copy in the 15th century, although a possible precursor is mentioned by Tacitus in describing Nero.

The whole thing is a meta-critique on how people can go crazy forming cults out of the weirdest things, and while they might not seem dangerous at first, at the minimum it can lead to disastrous life outcomes, dragging their friends and family down.

I've done what I can to embed it in the universe (the first Alpha instance was a guy obsessed with SCP-1425 Star Signals, but who'd never read that book - it turns out that was just his 'hobby obsession'). I definitely wouldn't mind some critiques from the more detail-oriented people in improving my cross-SCP references.

I hope you like the idea - tell me if/when you want it in Sandbox.

item.title: New author need greenlight for idea
item.description: I already wrote a draft but as a new author I have to get the idea greenlight first
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

Elevator Pitch:
1. To classify a new SCP found from a meteorite in Arizona.
2. This SCP is a class Euclid anomaly. It can be potentially harmful to humans but benefit other SCPs.
3. Documents the new SCPs origin and potential tie into other foundation members.
4. Is a physical manifestation of anti-matter.
5. This document also serves as a warning to other foundation members for what dangers lie may occur if humans have extended contact with this entity.

Central Narrative:
Hikers keep disappearing in Sedona Arizona. The foundation finds it is due to an SCP that “hatched” out of a meteorite that crashed down to earth. This entity is intangible and dangerous to humans after extended exposure to it, causing them to “disappear”. It has a limited radius of its effect. This entity is a sentient black fog. It could be potentially useful to the foundation as it seems to interact with other SCPs in a positive way. It also needs to stay contained, as without proper measure, moves sporadically.

Hook/Attention Grabber:
This SCP is unique in the sense that though it is as of now classified as a Euclid entity, with the right research, could potentially become a Thaumiel entity if used to enhance the abilities of other SCPs the foundation finds useful. It also has the potential to be a tie into how anti-matter can affect other SCPs and may further help to understand all SCPs abilities. Not much is known about anti-matter today which is why I think it would be cool to have an entity made of it to enhance the aspect of mystery.

Additional Notes:
I already wrote a rough draft for the SCP article, but I am a new writer, so I must have the idea greenlight before the draft. My main concern is if there is another SCP like this as I have not read every article. I also want to make sure that I leave a lot of information a mystery without being overly vague.
